newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Bnk may not recover 6 bln yen in Tokai loans.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bnk may not recover 6 bln yen in Tokai loans.

text.p: Daiwa Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that about six billion yen in loans to failed general contractor Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd may not be recoverable.
Tokai Kogyo, a medium-sized contractor, applied for court protection from creditors last Friday.
The bank will write off the loans using its reserves in the half year to September 30, the bank said in a statement.
The bank does not expect major changes in its earnings forecast for the current business year to March 31, 1998, the statement said.
